title: Mins to Broadway. Parking. Pool. Gym. Midtown Nash
description:
Welcome to your Scandinavian-style Nashville escape 🌿✨, a bright modern space with a queen bed 🛏️, sofa 🛋️, private balcony ☕, and access to a pool 🏊‍♂️, gym, and secure parking 🚘 just 7 minutes from Broadway 🎶.

The space
Welcome to your Scandinavian-styled Nashville retreat — a bright, modern, and thoughtfully curated space designed for comfort, calm, and effortless city living 🌿✨ Clean lines, warm textures, and minimalist décor create a stylish yet cozy atmosphere the moment you step inside.

Unwind in the comfortable living space 🛋️, enjoy a restful night in the plush queen-size bed 🛏️, or step out onto the private balcony for fresh air and a peaceful moment above the city ☀️. Just 7 minutes from Broadway 🎶, you’re perfectly positioned to enjoy Nashville’s world-class music, dining, and nightlife — then retreat to tranquility when the day winds down.

Take advantage of the resort-style pool 🏊‍♂️, secure private parking 🚘, and easy self check-in for a seamless stay from start to finish.

✨ Amenities You’ll Enjoy

🛏️ Comfortable queen-size bed
🛋️ Sofa that converts to sleep additional guests
🌿 Scandinavian-inspired furniture & décor
☀️ Private balcony
🏊‍♂️ Resort-style pool access
🚘 Secure private parking garage
⚡ High-speed WiFi
📺 Smart TV for streaming
🍳 Fully equipped kitchen
❄️ Central heating & air conditioning
☕ Coffee maker + essentials
🔒 Secure building & keyless entry
🌤️ Bright natural light throughout

Please note that building amenities are managed by the apartment complex-no refunds or discounts will be provided if they are temporarily unavailable.

Whether you’re visiting for work, a weekend getaway, or a music-filled Nashville escape, this thoughtfully designed space offers the perfect balance of style, comfort, and prime location 🤍✨

Guest access
Entire space & shared spaces such as lobby, courtyard,  game room, swimming pool and gym are included in the rental. Please make yourself at home in these spaces. 

We are not responsible for the closure or unavailability of any of these shared amenities, which is completely out of our control. Should this situation occur, we will not be able to refund any of your stay with us.

The pool is located on the 2nd floor and requires the key fob for access.
The trash chutes are located at the end of each hallway.

Other things to note
We want you to feel right at home during your stay 💛
